body.title: Terminal client approval prompt
body.summary: In the ink TUI (src/cli) add a service that opens approval.subscribe at attach and a view that shows each pending request inline (tool, repository, exact arguments, preview, time left) with approve and decline keys, answering through approval.answer and dropping the prompt on a cancel frame. Reconnect after a daemon restart.
acceptanceChecks: the client subscribes at attach and shows the tool, repository and arguments of a raised request
approve and decline send approval.answer with the request id
a cancel frame removes the prompt
the stream is reopened after the daemon restarts

tests.name: src/cli/services/__tests__/approval-subscribe.test.ts: the terminal client receives a gate frame, shows the tool, repository and arguments, and sends approval.answer
src/cli/services/__tests__/approval-subscribe.test.ts: a cancel frame removes the prompt and the stream is reopened after a restart
